name: Arkansas Anime Festival
blurb: Arkansas's largest anime convention, usually held in Springdale, currently on hiatus for 2026 with a hoped-for return in 2027.
notes: Homepage states: 'For the year of 2026, A2F will be taking a hiatus. We apologize to our beloved attendees. We appreciate your patience and understanding Please follow us for updates on 2027!' The last edition that actually ran was 2025-06-27 to 2025-06-29 (page title: 'Arkansas Anime Festival - June 27-29, 2025 | Springdale, AR'; text: 'The Arkansas Anime Festival returns to it's old home in Springdale, Arkansas for Summer 2025! 1500 South 48th Street Springdale, AR 72762'). No 2027 dates have been announced, so status is 'inactive' (hiatus) with editions left empty per RESEARCH.md.
